{"sections": [{"doc_id": "who_risk_comm", "key_facts": [], "score": 5.3826, "section_id": "who_risk_comm_chunk_0000", "snippet": "Risk communication and community engagement Risk communication is the real-time exchange of information, advice and opinions between experts or officials and people who face a hazard or threat to their survival, health, or economic or social wellbeing. The purpose of risk communication is to enable people at risk to make informed decisions to mitigate the effects of a threat (hazard) such as a disease outbreak and take protective and preventive measures.
